coaching.headline: An early four-kill lead went to shit in the team's own jungle, where Sparrow and The Fey died in the same fight three times.

flags.text: Drongo killed Sparrow three times and The Fey twice, finishing with the game's most hero damage.
The enemy's second Fangtooth fell with no ally dead; Genesis Core followed a minute later.
The enemy scored the last six kills, and seven allied structures fell in under two minutes, Core included.

focus.title: Shore up the duo side, then contest Fangtooth
focus.action: Play the duo side as three with the jungler until Drongo stops winning fights there, and when Fangtooth is up with all five alive, contest the pit as a group rather than concede it.

15.8.call: Feng Mao and Gideon had died in mid within the minute before, and Argus took the mid outer tower. Drongo then killed Sparrow and The Fey in the team's jungle, lost 0-2. After two mid deaths, giving ground on the duo side was the cheaper call.

17.4.call: Drongo killed Sparrow and Bayle killed The Fey in the team's jungle, lost 0-2, and Bayle killed Feng Mao outside any fight just before the enemy's first Fangtooth. Mini Prime went to the team a minute later, the right trade to look for.

23.8.call: Argus killed The Fey first; Sparrow, Scarlett and Feng Mao answered with kills on Argus, Drongo and Narbash before Bayle killed Feng Mao, won 3-2. Gideon took the enemy mid outer tower in the same window.

26.2.call: Right after the enemy's Fangtooth, Drongo killed The Fey and Argus killed Sparrow in the team's jungle, lost 0-2. With the pit already gone, the duo's job was grouping for Genesis Core, not trading.

29.2.call: Feng Mao killed Drongo, then Bayle killed The Fey, Feng Mao and Gideon across the mid and duo lanes, lost 1-3, Sparrow having died 46 seconds before. With a body down, two separate plays on two lanes were ones to give up, holding the inner towers together instead.

matchup: Bayle was the jungle opponent; the head-to-head kills ran three for Feng Mao and four for Bayle.
Dire Howl heals Bayle for a share of damage taken, and Salvation shields Bayle below 30% health.
Berserk fires when Bayle drops low, so Earth Shatter's execute is the clean finish.
build: Tainted Trident cuts healing by 45% on physical damage, against Bayle's Dire Howl heal and Narbash's healing.
Solstice carries both armors and is the only physical armor on the team against Drongo's physical damage.
The Perforator is the missing winning-core item: it ignores 30% of physical armor, against Steel's and Bayle's armor items.
eternal: Demiurge raises item stats and item-effect damage by 10%; Construct adds health and ability haste per level.
Bloatware adds damage and damage reduction per item, and four completed items fed the bonus.
Demiurge leans ahead of Lotus in the field for Feng Mao jungle, and Construct with Bloatware is Demiurge's best pair.
augment: Ichorous Glaive restores 4% missing health per unit kill, 35% on Earth Shatter executions.
Imperial Duelist is the field toss-up partner: against debuffed targets, deal 5% more damage and take 5% less, giving up healing.
crest: Ortus grants movement speed and physical power for 7s; takedowns inside that window add permanent physical power.
Ortus is the field's best Feng Mao jungle crest, clearly ahead of Nex, the most played.
improvement: The Perforator next completes the winning core, adding penetration and ability slows without selling Solstice's armor.
Sound keep on Demiurge, Ortus and Ichorous Glaive; the field gives no edge to a swap.

matchup: Steel was the lane opponent: first blood went to Scarlett, and Steel finished with the most damage mitigated in the game.
Steel's Shield Bash stuns, Bull Rush knocks heroes back, and Shield Slam knocks up and stuns.
Tainted Guard cuts the healing of any hero basic-attacking Steel and applies a bleed.
build: Mutilator's Devour applies max-health damage on ability hits, suited to Steel's health-stacked build.
Terminus turns lifesteal overhealing into a shield, which Tainted Guard's healing cut blunts against Steel.
No completed item or the crest carries magical armor, against an enemy team with three magical damage dealers.
eternal: Knell shreds both armors with Rust stacks on hits against heroes and returns 75% of the armor shredded.
Peal applies maximum Rust after Swan Song; Patina with Fracture is the field's best pair.
Knell is the field's best Scarlett offlane Eternal, clearly ahead of Marrow.
augment: Volcaic Slam makes Empowered Cindara leave an eruption that damages and slows by 40%.
Volcaic Slam is clearly the field's best Scarlett offlane augment. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses all debuffs and grants a shield, an answer to Steel's stuns and Drongo's Gag Grenade silence.
Gravitum leans ahead in the field: a long-range shot that grounds the first hero hit, giving up the cleanse.
improvement: The winning core is Alternator, Earthshaker and The Perforator; none was built.
One death and the team's most gold: no defensive swap was forced. If magical damage starts landing, magical armor replaces Rebirth's revive.

matchup: Argus was the mid opponent, a Vesh mage on Tithe of Death and Mind Rot, finishing 7/2/5.
Dread Nova stuns, Ether Crystal slows, and Synaptic Obliterator beams hit harder on targets missing health.
build: Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings are the full winning core, all three finished.
Spellbreaker's Veil blocks the next ability on a cooldown and adds magical armor against Argus's damage.
Wraith Leggings adds 12% ability damage against heroes below 40% health.
eternal: Vesh adds damage over time from ability damage on heroes; Tithe of Death restores mana and stacks ability haste on takedowns.
Phylactery speeds cooldowns and shields after Black Hole; The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the field's best Vesh pair.
Vesh holds the best odds in a field toss-up with Demiurge and Xyris on Gideon mid.
augment: Event Horizon adds max-health damage to enemies in Cosmic Rift's center.
Abyssal Mantle leans ahead in the field: a shield on activating Black Hole, giving up the Cosmic Rift damage.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer is the field's best Gideon mid crest, clearly ahead of Epoch. Sound keep.
improvement: Full winning core and the team's most hero damage: sound keep on the build.

matchup: Duo was Sparrow and The Fey against Drongo and Narbash; Drongo killed Sparrow three times, Sparrow killed Drongo twice.
Drongo's Wastelander bleed deals max-health damage on crits and ability hits, and Shrapnel Cannon shreds physical armor.
Narbash's Thunk stuns, and Narbash had the most healing in the game.
build: Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic-attacked targets, against Narbash's healing.
No item or the Pacifier crest carries armor or health against Drongo's physical damage.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when Sparrow damages a hero below 30% health.
Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster kill; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after leaving Heightened Senses' Stealth.
Thraex and Weald are a field toss-up on Sparrow carry; Forage with Wind-Rider is Weald's best pair.
augment: Endless Hunt resets basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and adds permanent physical penetration; five takedowns fed the stacks.
Sun Shards leans ahead in the field: ricocheting basic attacks, giving up the resets and penetration.
crest: Pacifier dashes and empowers the next physical hit, stronger on targets below 20% health.
Pacifier leans ahead of Eviscerator, the most played Sparrow carry crest. Sound keep.
improvement: The winning core is Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra; Sky Splitter was the one finished.
Spectra next adds attack speed and Prisma hits that grow with the target's missing health.

matchup: Duo was The Fey and Sparrow against Narbash and Drongo; before minute ten, the enemy duo died once, the allied duo never.
Bayle killed The Fey four times; Skull Crusher leaps in, and Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns.
Narbash's Thunk knocks back and stuns, and Narbash died once all game with twelve assists.
build: Combustion, Tainted Scepter and Megacosm are damage items; the support winning core is Crescelia, Timewarp and Astral Catalyst.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, against Narbash, the game's top healer.
Megacosm and Tainted Scepter add health, but no item carries armor against Bayle's and Drongo's physical damage.
eternal: Aion turns spell damage on heroes into gold; Philosopher drips gold and Perfection adds ability haste above 85% health.
The engine does not model support Eternals; the field's The Fey support toss-up is Aion, Lotus and Vesh.
augment: Wild Growth gives Bramble Patch 30% more range, the field's most played pick.
Natural Infusion leans ahead in the field: Harvest Nettles hits on heroes stack ability haste, giving up the range.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device puts The Fey in stasis, a few-games pick on The Fey support.
Tranquility and Silentium are the field's toss-up: gold over time and a third ward, which Epoch lacks.
improvement: With the lowest gold on the team, a support crest's gold income is the swap to test, giving up the stasis.
If Bayle keeps killing The Fey, an armor item next covers the physical damage the build leaves open.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

loadout.name: Volcaic Slam
loadout.text: Empowered Cindara leaves behind a rupture that erupts after 0.5s. The eruption deals 20 (+4 per Level) (+25%) Damage to Enemies and Slows by 40% for 1.25s.
loadout.plain: When an outer-edge Ashen Vow hit empowers your next Cindara, that lantern slam also leaves a rupture that erupts and slows. It gives your Ashen Vow into Cindara combo a second hit and makes it hard to walk out of.

loadout.name: Knell
loadout.text: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. Gain 75% of the Armors shredded.
loadout.plain: Every Cindara swing and ability on a hero adds Rust, cutting their armor and adding some to yours. Your fast stab and slam combos hit max Rust quickly, so longer trades against bruisers and tanks swing your way.

loadout.name: Patina
loadout.text: Gain a 30 (+14 per level) Shield when not taking damage for 10s. Gain 4% Movement Speed while the shield holds.
loadout.plain: A small shield and some move speed come back after you go untouched for 10s. Mostly a lane and roaming comfort piece; it softens the first poke before you dash in with First Intent.

loadout.name: Peal
loadout.text: Gain 15 Ultimate Ability Haste. Upon casting your ultimate, attacks and abilities apply maximum stacks of Rust for 4s. 20s cooldown.
loadout.plain: Swan Song comes back sooner, and casting it slaps max Rust on whoever you hit next. Your ultimate strike and the follow-up Minueta stabs land on a target with their armor already shredded.

loadout.name: Liberator
loadout.text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.
loadout.plain: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Save it for the slow or stun that would stop your First Intent dash, then go back in.
